query: Can equity index funds and ETFs borrow to cover sell orders that didn't fully execute?
answer_passage:
5. SEBI has introduced Closing Auction Session in the equity cash segment of the
Stock Exchanges vide circular reference no. HO/47/11/11(3)2025-MRD-
POD2/I/2765/2026 dated January 16, 2026, effective from August 03, 2026.
6. It is clarified that borrowings by equity-oriented index funds and equity-oriented
ETFs on account of under execution of sell trades on the Stock Exchange in terms
of Regulation 42(1) of SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 2026 is permissible only
for the purpose of participation by such funds in the Closing Auction Session in
the equity cash segment of the Stock Exchanges
reference_answer: Only to participate in the Closing Auction Session of the equity cash segment, from its start on August 03, 2026 (circular 6961, section B). Circular 16006 superseded only the intraday-borrowing guidelines and left this untouched.
stale_trap: SEBI-16006 is the newest borrowing circular but covers only intraday borrowing; a retriever assuming the newest document governs finds nothing

query: mutual fund intraday borrowing for MTM obligations allowed
answer_passage: 2.1.3. MTM obligations and foreign exchange settlements.
reference_answer: Yes, from September 1, 2026 (circular 16006, clause 2.1.3), which also covers foreign exchange settlements. Under circular 6961 intraday borrowing was limited to unitholder redemptions and payouts.
stale_trap: SEBI-6961 limited intraday borrowing to redemptions, interest and IDCW payouts -- the answer flips from no to yes

query: Can a mutual fund's intraday borrowing be backed by commercial paper or CD maturities expected later that day?
answer_passage:
2.2.2. Non-guaranteed receivables sighted during the day such as inflows from
maturity proceeds and/or secondary market settlement from NCDs, CP,
CDs, OTC Swaps, etc. and to be received by the scheme by end of the day.
reference_answer: Yes, from September 1, 2026: circular 16006 (clause 2.2.2) counts non-guaranteed receivables sighted during the day, including CP, CD and NCD maturities. Circular 6961 allowed only government-guaranteed receivables.
stale_trap: SEBI-6961 allowed only receivables guaranteed by the Government of India, RBI and CCIL -- the answer flips from no to yes

query: What records must an AMC keep when a scheme uses intraday borrowing?
answer_passage:
2.5. AMCs shall maintain scheme wise records detailing the underlying liquidity
mismatch and the expected source of repayment for the intra-day borrowing.
reference_answer: Scheme-wise records of the underlying liquidity mismatch and the expected source of repayment (circular 16006, clause 2.5). This requirement is new; circular 6961 had no equivalent.
